notes:
- **Back and Forward buttons.** Arrows at the top of the sidebar step back and
  forward through where you've been, just like a browser. **Alt+Left** /
  **Alt+Right** and your mouse's side buttons do the same, and every page's own
  Back button now returns to where you actually came from instead of Home.
- **Right-click a poster for quick actions.** In any library, Watch Later or
  Recently added, right-click a title to **add it to a collection** or **save it
  to Watch Later** without opening it.
- **Comments.** Every movie now has a comments section under its description,
  and every season of a show has a **Comments** button next to *Mark season
  watched*. Comments show everyone's name and profile picture; you can delete
  your own.
- **Movies as Extras.** Right-click a movie → **Make it an extra of a series…**
  to file it under a show's **Extras** tab — handy for anime films and
  specials. Pick the library, search for the show, confirm. To undo it,
  right-click it in the Extras tab → **Move back to Movies**.
- **Set up your profile.** If you haven't added a display name and picture yet,
  the app asks you once. Say no and it won't ask again — you can always do it
  later from your account menu.
- **Fixed a crash when playing Extras.** Clicking an OVA, special or other
  episode in a series' **Extras** tab closed the app. It plays normally now.
- **Admin: full library reindex and server backups.** Settings → Server has a
  **Reindex** button that fetches fresh info for every title, including older
  ones, after taking a backup. **Backups → Manage…** lists the server's
  snapshots and can restore one if something goes wrong.

---
Windows updates itself on the next launch. Linux updates through your system updater if you installed 2.6.8 or newer; if you are on an older version, download the `.deb` below and install it once more.
